The information required for quantum key distribution can be encoded in the physical properties of the photons, such as their polarisation, phase or timing. This activity shall design, buildand qualify a faint pulse source for space-based quantum key distribution applications. This shall include a first conceptual system design to define the interfaces and requirements for a technology demonstration mission. The faint pulse source hardware shall include the laser source itself, as well as the required optics and electronics to control the photon states.
